title_en: The Dangers of Infiltrating the Appointment System of the Religious Authority
description_en: His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, the dangers of infiltrating the appointment system of the religious authority (marja'iyya).
summary: His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari addresses the risks and vulnerabilities regarding the appointment system of the religious authority (marja'iyya).
